body: apps2/mud/main.go: npcDef{ID,Name,ZoneID,Greeting} + 3 NPCs (guildmaster/merchant/scout). questBank global. questJournal on player. Commands: npcs (list zone NPCs), talk <id> (dialogue + quest list), quest-accept, quest-turn-in (rewards gil+item from inventory), quests/qlog (active+completed log). RecordKill() called on mob death with inline quest progress notification. All tests pass.
title: S104-04: NPC dialogue MUD wiring — npcs/talk/quest-accept/quest-turn-in/quests commands
